MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #2
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x

2. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27.7
   C. 27
   D. 33

3. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

4. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 27 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

5. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 7
   C. 36
   D. 6

6. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 49

7. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 21
   C. 15.6
   D. 15

8. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 31
   D. 1

9. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 2/2

10. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 37
   D. 1

11. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23.7
   C. 23
   D. 23.6

12. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 75
   C. 30
   D. 40

13. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19
   C. 19.7
   D. 25

14. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 21
   C. 42
   D. 90

15. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 66
   C. 17
   D. 34

16. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 2
   D. 1

17. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 22
   C. 32
   D. 55

18. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 100
   B. 11
   C. 50
   D. 10

19. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.6
   C. 31.7
   D. 31

20. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

21. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 25

22. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x > 5
   C. x < 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

23. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

24. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 72
   C. 73
   D. 17

25. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 7
   C. 49
   D. 14

26. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 48
   C. 24
   D. 156

27. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 3
   C. 15
   D. 21

28. Solve for x: x + 8 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 7
   C. 8
   D. 8

29. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 4

30. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 33
   C. 4
   D. 12

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

33. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

34. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

35. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

36. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

37. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

38. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

39. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

40. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
